description: Text Match Slicer is a Power BI custom visual that helps report users search and filter text columns using words, quoted phrases, wildcards and Any/All matching. It is designed for reports that contain free-text data such as feedback, comments, notes, case descriptions, survey responses, service requests and operational records. Users can search for one or more terms, switch between matching any term or all terms, and apply the results as a normal Power BI filter so other visuals in the report update.
